title: APES CIC Tickets and Cases
summary: Added the complete owner- and permission-scoped APES CIC Cases workflow while strengthening Tickets with instance isolation, explicit reply visibility, reusable activity, and analytics contracts.
changes: Added APES CIC Cases with categories, priorities, assignment, terminal transitions, public updates, internal staff notes, private notifications, and bounded audit metadata.
Added explicit sub-core storage and instance-scoped authorization, lifecycle detectors, dashboard summaries, recent hub activity, and typed analytics providers for APES CIC Tickets and Cases.
Expanded the compatible Shelter case store additively, preserved existing record and audit identities, and installed APES CIC Cases as the sixth shipped module instance.
affected_areas: APES CIC Tickets and Cases, shared case storage, module registry, dashboard, sub-core hub, authorization, notifications, analytics, and rollback compatibility
version_rationale: A backward-compatible minor application release adding the planned APES CIC Cases capability and reusable module-provider contracts.
validation: Focused migration, registry, lifecycle, owner/staff workflow, privacy, dashboard, activity, analytics, and rollback-contract coverage is included; full environment verification is recorded with the implementation handoff.
known_limitations: Shelter Tickets, Pet Care Tickets, ticket-to-case escalation, the Admin analytics interface, module uninstall, ASM integration, release, deployment, and production verification remain outside this release.
After the sixth module installation is persisted, v0.12.1 cannot represent the database state; recovery requires the pre-deployment backup and established database recovery boundary.
rollback: Before deployment, take and verify the normal backup. Once apes-cic:cases is persisted, the existing fail-closed compatibility checker rejects code rollback to v0.12.1 with target_contract_unrepresentable; restoring the pre-deployment backup/database state is the recovery boundary.
provenance: Defined by the APES CIC Tickets and Cases delivery for MyAPES Account issue #12.
